limitation: All primary annotations and adjudication come from one model family and one model configuration. Repeated fresh runs may share correlated systematic errors. Agreement therefore measures repeated-run consistency rather than independent-model agreement.
reason: The originally preregistered model configurations were unavailable in the operator-visible environment. Claude Sonnet 5.5 Extra was the available approved annotation model. The substitution was fixed before any annotation or effectiveness analysis.
